newsitem.title: UK: Thailand's first Boots chemist shop to open.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's first Boots chemist shop to open.

text.p: Britain's biggest retail pharmacist Boots Co Plc will officially open its first store in Thailand on Thursday as part of plans to expand its highly successful Boots the Chemist internationally.
The group aims to open five stores in Thailand over the summer, four in Bangkok and one in the resort town of Pattaya. The overseas expansion was first announced last October.
Last week, Boots opened its first shop in the Netherlands in Rotterdam and it is also looking to open outlets in Japan.
The shops in Thailand will be between 200 and 700 square metres and closely resemble Boots the Chemists UK stores in appearance and layout.
All will have a pharmacy and stock fragrances, toiletries and cosmetics, including international brands, local products and Boots own-brands such as No7 and Natural Collection.

Boots said it had chosen Thailand for its overseas pilot stores in South East Asia because of the rapidly growing middle class population with high disposable incomes. The Thai health and beauty market is expected to double in real terms over the next 10 years.
Boots stores in Bangkok are located in the Siam Centre, SCAB Park Plaza, UBC2 Building, Sukhumvit and Future Park Rangsit.
The company has invested about 30 million pounds over two years in the pilot scheme, but has stressed the experimental nature of its overseas expansion.

Boots has joined the growing list of British retailers with international ambitions. Marks and Spencer Plc already has stores and franchised operations in Europe and Asia, and a number of others have rapidly growing franchise businesses.
